Rat.one_line_summary: symbol of wealth and cultural intelligence
Rat.personality_and_characteristics: Clever and energetic, quick thinkers who tire quickly Optimistic but can't stand hot weather Successful, but content with living a quiet and peaceful life Sensitive to others emotions
Rat.most_compatible_with_description: [rat/ox] Rat and Ox are connections quickly formed by their complement to one another in both work and life. They share their straight-forwardness, loyalty, and respect for personal space.  [rat/dragon] Connections formed by an expressive Rat and passionate Dragon will be able to quickly understand each other (and well) while enjoying an optmistic-looking future. [rat/monkey] Similar to Dragons, Monkeys are able to get along great with Rats and can appear picture-perfect since both like some healthy competition while giving each other the support they need to thrive.
Rat.best_to_learn_from_description: [rat/horse]It seems no matter what a Rat does, it won't be enough for the Horse. It can be difficult for the Rat to shake off this effect. It's just the nature of the personalities interacting.   [rat/goat]While both loyal and admire the others artistic eye, the Rat and Goat share a mutual understanding of the need for financial security, although the Goat can grow tired of the Rat's doubtful view of the world. That being said, the Rat may grow annoyed by the Goats' daydreaming. [rat/rabbit] The Rabbit may purposely or seemingly unintentionally go against the Rat’s wishes, while the Rat only keeps silent.

Ox.flowers: Lily of the Valley and Lucky Bamboo
Ox.personality_and_characteristics: Honest and earnest Diligent; persistence that is a unique ability that allows them to overcome many obstacles Sensible; lives life within the guard rails Reliable; hard working without asking for much praise
Ox.most_compatible_with_description: [rat/ox] Rats and Ox are drawn like a magnet with complementing personalities and are both running towards the same goal in life – they're stronger together![ox/snake] Not only will Snakes give warmth, but they offer endless help and support in work too. [ox/rooster] Honest and loyal, Ox can also be drawn to the Rooster’s soft and open-hearted nature.
Ox.best_to_learn_from_description: [goat/ox] While the Goat feels more powerful and shielded by the Ox, the demands set by the Ox sometimes weighs heavy on the Goat. The Goat often feels they don't enjoy the day-to-day of life, while the Ox sees this as a little reckless. They can tolerate each other’s differences, but there will always be tension. [horse/dog]Horses, in their free and untamed spirit, can take the matters of life less seriously than others and seemingly runs unshackled from any structure. This is the opposite of an Ox’s personality. [Ox/dog]With Dogs, there can be an initial battle to find any common ground.

Tiger.personality_and_characteristics: Freedom; universally respected and known for their courage and independence Courageous; active and enjoys challenges with adventure Spontaneous;  goes from being fiery and fearless to calm and emotional in a blink Daring; fearless and passionate
Tiger.most_compatible_with_description: [tiger/horse] Both of you share a lot in common and will have joyous and abundant energy. You both enjoy moving towards a common goal together and make healthy progress, creating a balance of being active and confident in various things. Plus, neither of you will be lazy in your unrelenting effort to build and grow stronger. [tiger/pig] Tiger and Pig are excellent at motivating each other. The Tiger is high-spirited while the Pig is kind-hearted and generous toward others, which the compassionate Tiger always appreciates. They will know how to attract each other’s attention and will be a very forgiving interaction – even if one falls short of expectations in one area, this shortcoming will likely be counteracted by their mate. [tiger/dog] A natural match as both are idealists who are kind and charitable, always looking out for the other. Tigers can be temperamental, which does not scare the Dog, who excels at using diplomacy to comfort the impulsive Tiger. They will be able to give each other the understanding and the support they need and will enjoy physical and mental peace—a feeling of being at ease in others' presence. As the relation matures, both are likely to become even more generous and humble.
Tiger.best_to_learn_from_description: [tiger/monkey]The Tiger is strong-willed and ambitious, though can be deaf when listening to others’ ideas; the same can be said for the Monkey, who can be temperamental and unwilling to back down. The Tiger and Monkey may quarrel over the smallest things, neither willing to take that step back. [tiger/snake]With the Tiger being passionate and direct while the Snake is cautious and suspicious, the pairing appears to be in opposite nature, who will find difficulty when it comes to clearly understanding each other and their movives. Snakes can find Tigers overpowering and the Tiger may find the Snake hard to get to know. Without this ability to communicate and understand each other, these two may keep aware of the communication flaw.

Rabbit.personality_and_characteristics: To outsiders, quiet and delicate, which hides their confidence and strength Social; attractive aura and affinity for aesthetic and beauty Attentive; careful and conservative actions Earnest; always steadily moving towards their goal
Rabbit.most_compatible_with_description: [rabbit/dog] Both the Dog and Rabbit wish for a peaceful and quiet life. They'll take the same strides towards this dream and enjoy it together. Rabbit and Pig have similar personalities and will be attracted to each others spiritual nature and these shared common ground and qualities. [rabbit/goat] Goats enjoy someone who they can depend on, and Rabbits enjoy taking care of others which can complement Goats like the perfect puzzle piece.
Rabbit.best_to_learn_from_description: [rabbit/rooster]The quiet and opinonated Rabbit and talkative Rooster can find the smallest things to argue about, even the volume on the TV can be a reason for a little squarrel. If you both can be more clear and direct, these tensions can go away. [rabbit/dragon]The possessive Dragon and Rabbits tend to be aligned with similar goals and interests, however, their charisma and self-praise may cause some clashes as the Rabbit feels the need to feed their ego. [rabbit/rat]Interactions between Rabbits and Rats can be tricky as their differences will appear over time and can become increasingly difficult to agree with each other.

Dragon.personality_and_characteristics: Independent; strong figures but yearn for love and support Perfectionists; set high standards Intuitive; outspoken, quick and always thinking Natural tendency to take on leadership and exert influence
Dragon.most_compatible_with_description: [dragon/rooster] Dragons love Roosters since the Rooster will look up to the Dragon and provide unceasing support during any hardship. [dragon/monkey] Both Monkeys and Dragons are creative and innovative, and appreciate that about each other. But once together, keep an eye on the Monkey as they like to play tricks. [dragon/rat] The Rat’s humor and reliability attracts the stubborn Dragon to their prescence time and time again. Initially the different personalities may clash but overtime pleasantly complement each other, showering one other with trust, but also their own freedom.
Dragon.best_to_learn_from_description: [dragon/dog] Dragons and Dogs have clashing personalities since they both find neither trusts nor understands the other. This connection is easily chained by establishing the freedom from suspicion. [dragon/rabit] While the Rabbit has similar interests as Dragons, they will find they can only tolerate each other for a limited window of time. Allowing time between interactions calms the water. [dragon/dragon] Dragons aren't compatible with other Dragons since both are ever so independent and stubborn to see themself glow in their fire, they’ll clash and it’s hard to maintain a peaceful relationship.

Snake.personality_and_characteristics: Sophisticated; not fans of small talk or thinking about small everyday problems Stable; eye of the storm and able to hold their ground while calmly thinking of solutions Behind the calm demeanor, alert and observant Wise; intuitive and trust their own vibrations
Snake.most_compatible_with_description: [snake/monkey] Monkey and Snakes are a genuine pair who offer each other strong encouragement. While they do have similar traits, the interaction has a yin and yang effect. The sometimes reserved Monkey appreciates the energy and charm the Snake's prescence provides. [snake/rooster] The calm, sunbathing Snake and the fast-paced Rooster may seem very different at first, but the Rooster’s natural ability to uplift the mood in the room and their similar tastes draws in the Snake. [snake/ox] The practical Snake offers the Oxen warmth and a feeling that their hearts sync up to the same beat. Constantly learning off one another, the open-minded Snake can bring the Oxen out of their comfortable shell.
Snake.best_to_learn_from_description: [snake/tiger] It can take time for a Snake and Tiger to sympathize and understand each other and their motives. At first, this relationship can be full of suspect and coldness. [snake/pig] Snakes and Pigs can work well together, but there is a lack of constructive communication between the two which often results in a growing lack of trust in the relationship.

Horse.personality_and_characteristics: Full of energy; albeit a bit too much Ever-changing emotions; short fused tempers but once it’s over, forgotten quickly Studious and athletic; strong believers of chasing dreams Adventurous and rebellious; motivated by happiness over wealth and fame
Horse.most_compatible_with_description: [horse/goat] Horse and Goat are a high-spirited, energetic pair who each feels they have what the other needs. Despite these contrasting personalities, the Horse are drawn by the Goat’s tenderness, while the Goat will be influenced by the Horses' sense of adventure. Also, the Goat's reliance only makes a Horse feel content. [horse/tiger[ The Tiger and Horse are led like a carrot, only with their emotions. This will see them in the same boat, if emotions align. If the Tiger is willing to put the extra effort for a Horse, this pair is an unbreakable force. [horse/dog] While both independent in their minds and actions, the realist and protective Dog and diligent Horse pairing will thrive, although only once they respect each's own personal space.
Horse.best_to_learn_from_description: [horse/rat] The optimistic Horse and opportunistic Rat have strong opinions and social personalities. The Rat will want to show their attachment and want the Horse to settle down. The Rat will also show sensitivity to very different occasions when compared with the Horse. [horse/ox] With Ox, they will seek and crave stability while the Horse may come across too free-spirited and extroverted for the unruffled Ox. There may be obstacles in communication and may struggle to find common ground due to these opposite traits. [horse/horse] Horses can be incompatible with themselves due to their wild and spontaneous nature. They will cooperate well with each other due to the mirror effect but due to these striking similarities, there will be growing pains in maintaining a lasting connection.

Goat.personality_and_characteristics: Perseverance; notable ability to push through any difficulty Quiet observers; observant and will consider all aspects of anything Reliable; delicate, organized thoughts with an inner resilience Generous and empathetic; always forgiving of others but defensive at times
Goat.most_compatible_with_description: [goat/horse] The Goat and Horse is a harmonious pair as both help to make up for the others shortcomings. While the early days may have some conflicts due to the opposite personalities, the Goat leans of the adventurous and bubbly side of the Horse, and Horses help Goats come out of their shell and feel comfortable and assured by their side. [goat/pig] Pigs share many similar qualities as Goats, notably their wild imaginations and deep connection they with with the outer world and their emotions. Since means they attract and support each other. [goat/rabbit] Goats need someone to depend on, and Rabbits are the best answer; they both see the world together through their creative lenses and in a constant game to outdo each others generosity.
Goat.best_to_learn_from_description: [Goat/Ox] The stubbornness is shared between both the Ox and Goat, therefore if neither is willing to take a step back or take blame, there will be consistent problems. [goat/rat] With Rats, it’s easy for misunderstandings to come up and weaken the connection. While the Rat will energize and create social environments for the Goat to enjoy (sometimes too often), the Goats actually prefers the solidarity, peace and quiet compared to the chatty Rat. [goat/dog] While gentle Goats have similar interests with Dogs, the Dogs'  logic and glass-half-full attitude takes its toll on the Goat. Both are sensitive to the opinions of others and so any outside opinon can create a rumble in the connection.

Monkey.personality_and_characteristics: Clever; witty, lively and competitive Confident; always ready to face challenge with courage Active listeners; take critique and learn from their mistakes Cheeky; quick humor and crafty opportunists
Monkey.most_compatible_with_description: [money/snake] The relationship between Monkeys and Snakes is very extreme. They are either the most compatible or clash the strongest. They have similar personalities – one is yin and the other is yang. [monkey/rat] Rats are constantly able to cheer Monkeys up when they're feeling down. Together, the room is always full of laughter. [monkey/dragon] The Dragon brings great joy to Monkeys, while Monkeys love a decisive, driven and upbeat environment with a little competition.
Monkey.best_to_learn_from_description: [monkey/tiger] Monkeys and Tigers are suspicious of each other and can find themselves in a squabble. Let your guards down. [monkey/pig] Pigs have seemingly opposite life goals and interests as Monkeys and so it’s difficult to find that same wavelength on big-picture ideas, and sometimes with daily communication, making short-lived connections.

Rooster.personality_and_characteristics: Charming, witty and brave with actions Serious; straightforward, blunt and decisive Active; talkative, outspoken and open Acute observers and detail-oriented
Rooster.most_compatible_with_description: [rooster/dragon] The Rooster is always willing to support the Dragon, who is enamored by the bold and fiery qualities the Dragon possesses.  [rooster/snake] The quick acting Rooster and Snakes are able to butt heads without causing much drama, and together, able to discuss life and chase after their dreams of power and prestige. [rooster/ox] The Ox’s honesty and conservativeness fits well with the well-mannered, sophisticated Rooster. Their relationship develops steadily overtime to reach a perfect melody of qualities.
Rooster.best_to_learn_from_description: [rooser/rabbit] The Rooster and Rabbit's contrasting opinions lead them to down a road of confusion and frustration where both can't understand the other, resulting in several clashes. [rooster/dog] Roosters and Dogs have a aloof relationship and alhough they can tolerate each other, it’s seemingly flooded with tension. Retract your claws and embrace! [rooster/rooster] Roosters can also be incompatible with themselves; they fight often, mostly since they can't compromise.

Dog.personality_and_characteristics: Honest and loyal; will never abandon their friends, family or work Popular; everyone's hub for fun, advice and help Worried and anxious inside, however, unstoppable Decisive; once mind has been made on something, no one can persuade otherwise
Dog.most_compatible_with_description: [dog/rabbit] Dogs and Rabbits is a favorable pairing. While appearing different in their qualities at first, Dogs will quickly feel the click. They are attracted to the Rabbit’s kindness, while the Rabbit is easily able to calm the Dog down and avoid any conflict. [dog/tiger] A very understanding connection where Dogs are often pessimistic and needs a Tiger’s reassurance, and Tigers yearn for a Dog’s loyalty. [dog/horses] With Horses, both can balance each other out and respect each other’s opinions without much doubt. Dogs and Horses are hard to pull apart from each other.
Dog.best_to_learn_from_description: [dog/dragon] Sincere Dogs and suspicious Dragons can clash only because neither fully trusts the other, and with the Dragon's possessiveness and directness of Dogs, can lead to dramatic arguments. [dog/ox] At first, the relationship of the Oxen and Dog is distant and standoffish mostly due to their different interests and by rsult can't interact smoothly. [dog/goat] Dogs and Goats are able to easily tolerate each other and quickly predict the other's wants and desires, but the worry is that since both are so sensitive, they can break the connection as quickly as it was formed.

Pig.personality_traits: Loving, Tolerant, Honest, Appreciative of luxury
Pig.personality_and_characteristics: Realistic; the opposite of 'all talk, no action' Hands-on; materialistic, thoughtful and creative Enthusiastic; can make the mundane fun Curious and noble
Pig.most_compatible_with_description: [pig/tiger] Together, Pigs and Tigers see the world of color around them. They both want to wander and discover the beauty around them while seflessly working to support each other. These brave Tigers will give Pigs the security they long for. [pig/rabbit] This like-minded pair share similar ideals for a happy and prosperous life. The Rabbit is attracted by the Pig’s intelligence while the Pig appreciates their thoughtful nature and advice. They must, however, not let sharp comments get the better of their sensitive sides. [pig/goat] An imaginative, sometimes shy, Goat and the social Pig pair share many common interests. Together, they can feel unshakeable and can enjoy each others support without feeling they need to offer something in return.
Pig.best_to_learn_from_description: [pig/snake] Pigs and Snakes have so much in common, although on paper opposites. They seemingly have biases against each other and cannot understand the reasoning behind the others' actions. [pig/monkey] Pigs couldn't think to tell a lie while Monkey's are the ultimate pranksters. So, as much fun as guillable Pigs and Monkeys can have together, they equally wind each other up.
